theme: color-blocked (dynamic scroll-driven transition from dark to light)

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-[10vw] leading-none tracking-tighter uppercase font-black font-outfit

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 shadow-2xl (dark surfaces) OR backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/5 border border-black/10 (light surfaces)
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay (pointer-events-none) across the entire site to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Rounded soft radii (rounded-3xl) for menu cards; sharp edges for overarching layout sections to emphasize color-blocking.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep, saturated ambient shadows instead of gray dropshadows (e.g., shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(27,58,92,0.4)])

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (z-50). Fully transparent at top, frosted glass on scroll. Uses Inter font, simple text links, and a pill-shaped Amber Gold CTA. DO NOT use completely transparent background when scrolled over content.
components_strategy.hero: Three.js (R3F) full-viewport canvas. Floating paper lanterns emitting soft ethereal light, ambient particles. Massive 'FOUR LOST CATS' title with framer-motion masked line-by-line reveal.
components_strategy.cards: Tabbed Menu: Frosted glass cards with 3D tilt effect on hover. Real product photography treated deliberately (spotlight, clipped frames).
components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped backgrounds. Amber Gold gradient, Charcoal text. Scale up 1.05 on hover with subtle colored shadow.
components_strategy.marquee: Slow editorial text ticker running horizontally, overlapping section borders. Uses outline typography.

layouts.general: Section-based color blocking. Scroll transition triggering background color changes (Deep Blue -> Warm Peach).
layouts.spacing: Massive padding. py-32 to py-48 for major sections. gap-12 to gap-24 for grid items. Use 'breathing room' generously.

grid_modes.origin_story: Split screen. Left: sticky numbered manifesto chapters. Right: scrolling images.
grid_modes.gallery: Horizontal scrolling section pinned via Framer Motion useScroll. Images taking 70vh, varying widths.
grid_modes.menu: Bento-style 3-column grid, tight spacing. Highly legible list formats for 32 items.
grid_modes.architecture: Zig-zag layout, overlapping images and text to replicate the physical split level of the cafe.

motion.scrolling: Lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. Mandatory for Awwwards feel.
motion.reveals: Framer motion: masked text reveals (initial {y: '100%'} animate {y: '0%'} with overflow hidden wrappers).
motion.parallax: Subtle mouse parallax on hero cat silhouette. Image parallax (y transform) on scroll for gallery elements.
motion.micro_interactions: Magnetic effect on nav links, 3D tilt on cards.
motion.loading: Immersive 3D loading screen (0-100% counter) dissolving into the Three.js hero.

3d_libraries.instructions: Place <Canvas> as a fixed or absolute background. Use <Environment> for realistic lighting on floating paper lantern geometries. Add simple glowing particles. Keep performance high with suspense.

blueprint.section_1_hero: Loading screen -> Three.js Hero. Masked text reveal. Mouse-tracking parallax.
blueprint.section_2_origin: Origin story split section. Manifesto chapters. Blue background.
blueprint.section_3_architecture: Scroll-triggered gradient from Deep Blue to Warm Peach. Zigzag images of interior.
blueprint.section_4_menu: Interactive tabbed menu showcase. 32 items, 7 categories. Glass cards.
blueprint.section_5_events: Event space showcase with floating elements.
blueprint.section_7_testimonials: Auto-scrolling testimonials ticker + animated stat counters.
blueprint.section_8_visit_footer: Charcoal Visit Us info hub. Instagram grid. Cat-themed footer with easter egg tail, editorial marquee.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients meets APCA standards. Apply text-shadow if needed.
accessibility.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic flat gradients. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Apply transitions explicitly to avoid breaking transforms.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Preserve natural reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Generous padding creates a premium feel.
Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll-reveals.
Use the provided image_urls. Missing categories MUST NOT be replaced by dummy placeholder text or generic placeholder URLs.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
Always explicitly set text color on hover. Do not rely on inheritance.
Provide clear focus states for accessibility.
Ensure 3D scenes have adequate lighting so objects are clearly visible.
Incorporate the required fonts via Google Fonts import in CSS.
When customizing shadcn/ui components, strip the 'Vercel-look' and apply the Four Lost Cats brand styling (color-blocking, glassmorphism, bold borders).
